verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a payments platform that holds customer data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion or redaction features, or privacy-request handling. Generic API DELETE methods via MCP and sandbox-only object deletion in Workbench are developer building blocks, not a retention or deletion capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
